attempts.notes: Parrot's own product sheet confirms that the ANAFI USA MIL variant uses an AES-256 encrypted Microhard radio communication system (Microhard pDDL1800 1.8 GHz data link, Microhard Systems of Calgary, Canada); the standard Anafi USA appears to use Parrot's own Wi-Fi link, documented only via FCC filings (2AG6IANAFIM3) with confidential block diagrams/schematics. No public source identified the RF/radio chipset inside the module, so tier 2 is empty.
